name: regression-hallucinated-template-quotes
description: Captured from a real session where Stage A returned nine flag candidates and five credit candidates, every single one with template legal phrasing that never appears in the actual document. quoteAppearsInDocument must drop all of them, leaving Stage A output empty and lowRecall=true so the side panel shows the confidence notice.

expectedReason: Every Stage A flag quote is a verbatim copy of canonical legal phrasing that does NOT appear in the document. quoteAppearsInDocument drops all nine flags before verifier ever sees them. The five credits do appear in the document but the verifier rejects them as wrong-category. Final output: no flags, no credits, lowRecall flag is set so the UI can warn the user.
